Consult request from the member of the public who brought the animal to the facility.

Red-tailed hawk, hatch-year, admitted at 22% below expected weight, weak, with mildly increased respiratory effort. Emaciation in hatch-year raptors this season is commonly simple starvation, which carries a good prognosis with careful refeeding. It is also a common presentation of aspergillosis, which carries a poor prognosis and requires entirely different management. Bloodwork, radiographs, and an aspergillus antigen test are available today.
